title: The Other Applications of Concresoil
description: Akim seems to be troubled by something...

mainQuestExcel.title: The Other Applications of Concresoil
mainQuestExcel.description: Akim seems to be troubled by something...

dialogs.text: I still need more materials...
How's your Concresoil coming along?
Amazing, actually! As it turns out, this soil can be used for a wide variety of purposes.
For example, it can be used to make pottery and fix cracks in houses.
With a small adjustment of the mix ratio, I can even build houses with this soil.
However... I'm running low on materials due to a surge in orders.
Critically, I've ran out of Slime Condensate. Traveler, could you please bring me three more portions of Slime Condensate?
Leave it to me.
So, Traveler, could you please fetch three more portions of Slime Condensate for me?
What about other materials?
I have made purchases from different channels or asked others for help.
I just didn't expect that Slime Condensate could run out so quickly...

flow.stepDescription: Give three portions of Slime Condensate to Akim

dialogs.text: Traveler, have you obtained the Slime Condensate?
Thank you. Then I have all the materials I need for now.
Give me a second while I mix the Concresoil...
Akim starts to mix the soil...
Okay, it's done. Please take the soil to Nima.
He has been waiting for it for ages.
This child is... um... unusually imaginative.
Nima told me he wanted to make a group of talking "pot warriors" that can roll over enemies and have all sorts of magical powers.
The power of these warriors will vary with the materials stuffed in their pot bodies.
He even gave these pot warriors a name, called Ad... Well, forget it, I don't remember.
Unfortunately, I can't really make pot warriors with magical powers. But still, it's an interesting idea.
So I thought, why not give him the soil as a toy gift?
This way, he can make his own pot warriors and command them like a general!
Ahem, anyway, please help me send this pot of soil to Nima.
Once his pot warriors are complete, maybe he will appoint us both "pot generals" as well!
#Hello, {F#Miss}{M#Mister}, what can I do for you?
Hurry and give the soil to Nima. He must be anxious from all the waiting.
Wow, this must be the soil that can make everything. Just like Akim told me!
#Yay! Thank you, {M#Mister}{F#Miss}!
Now I can make "Adri"!
What is Adri, anyway?
#Didn't Akim tell you about it, {M#Mister}{F#Miss}?
I'm making some pot warriors. Adri is gonna be the first and the best of them!
He is a kind warrior with a good temper. When he awakens as a pot warrior, the first thing he will do is to apologize to the grass under him.
His power is... is...
I—I haven't decided on it yet... but you'll be the first to know once I have!
After Adri is done, I'll make Ivar, his adjutant, and Lasson, his disciple.
The three of them... no, the three pot warriors... They will embark on a long, long journey...
I still need more materials...
How's your Concresoil coming along?
Amazing, actually! As it turns out, this soil can be used for a wide variety of purposes.
For example, it can be used to make pottery and fix cracks in houses.
By making small adjustment to the mix ratio, I can even build houses with this soil.
However... I'm running low on materials due to a surge in orders.
Even the Whopperflower soil has run out... Traveler, could you please go and get me some more of that?
Leave it to me.
Thank you. Don't forget, it's the soil where Whopperflowers grow that we're looking for!
What about other materials?
I've made purchases through various means and asked others for help.
But I'm out of this particular type of soil. I really should have stored more of it...

flow.stepDescription: Head to where the Whopperflower appeared

dialogs.text: Did you get the soil?

flow.stepDescription: Bring the sample back to Akim

dialogs.text: Did you get the soil?
Thank you, these should last me for a while.
I'm thinking that there might be other ways to improve the Concresoil...
For example, perhaps the soil can also be highly water-retentive and nutrient-rich...
*sigh* I'm just not smart enough. If it was those wise folks, they would have definitely come up with more good ideas...
Traveler! Thank goodness you're here. I was just in need of someone's help!
So you've made progress in your soil research?
Well... I don't think I could call it "progress," but a customer of mine did give me some useful advice.
He said that he enjoys growing flowers and the thing that troubles him most is finding the right soil.
The soil needs to have good permeability and adequate nutrients. Plus, it should be water retentive but not soggy...
Knowing that I've made such improvements to the Concresoil, he asked me if I could devise a version of it for flowers.
I found it worth researching, so I'm looking for other materials to further upgrade my Concresoil.
Could you please help me look for some fertile soil this time?
I'll mark the location of the soil on the map for you.
Why is it so far away...
I asked around, of course. It's a little out of the way, but they say the soil there is very fertile.
But there seems to be a lot of monsters over there too, so I wouldn't dare to go myself...
I'm counting on you, Traveler!
How did you find this place...?

flow.stepDescription: Go to the place Akim recommended

dialogs.text: Did you get the soil?

flow.stepDescription: Bring the sample back to Akim

dialogs.text: Did you get the soil?
This is exactly what I'm looking for! Thank you so much.
Please take these as your reward.
Well... as fertile as it is, this soil is pretty weighty, and it doesn't seem to have great permeability...
Hmm... I'd better mix it with some other soil types...
Ugh, this is awful. Where did I go wrong...
What's going on?
Ah! It's... it's you, Traveler...
*sigh* There's something wrong with my Concresoil...
Was it the mix ratio? Or the lack of experimental trials...
Many customers who have built their kitchens using Concresoil have reported cracking after only a few days.
Perhaps the temperature grew so high that some parts of the soil just failed to work?
*sigh* Anyway, I have to go fix those cracks for them.
There were too many people needing repairs for me to take all the scraped Concresoil away, so I asked them to just keep it in some pots. And ah, there were very many pots indeed...
Traveler, could you please help me collect the used Concresoil from this house, while I go to another one?
*sigh* Where did it all go wrong...
I'll go to the other places to retrieve the Concresoil. You should hurry too. I'm counting on you.
Did you get those pots of Concresoil back?
Thank you. I'll evaluate this batch of soil.
How could this happen? Do I need to adjust the ratio again...
Ugh, why is making the ideal soil so hard?
